detail.longDescription: 🐬 NEW: Off # Australia ’s east coast, a common bottlenose # dolphin nicknamed Bubbles chases individual bigeye # trevally until they regurgitate, then eats the vomit. Researchers recorded 20 foraging attempts between 2021 and 2025, succeeding 11 times, and documented the # behavior in a September study.
